## IdentityReferenceData interface

Data form of one object denoted by its identifier.

**Signature:**

```typescript
interface IdentityReferenceData<Id = unknown, R extends string = string>
```

## Remarks

`id` is the app-defined identifier in its SDK form, as the resource's identifier value type decodes it.
